title: Increasing cDNA Yields from Single-cell Quantities of mRNA in Standard Laboratory Reverse Transcriptase Reactions using Acoustic Microstreaming
protocol: Equilibrate the micromixer to 37°C for at least 1 hour.
Set up the RT mix according to the reverse transcriptase supplier's instructions.
Use single-cell amounts of input total RNA in the range of 0.1-1pg/μl.
Position RT tubes into the micromixer as soon as they are ready for mixing.
Select a frequency and amplitude of micromixing, using 150Hz as an example.
Switch the micromixer on and leave it running for 60 minutes.
Switch the micromixer off once the RT reaction is complete.
Take the RT tubes out and place them on ice.
Proceed with further applications such as quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (qPCR or real-time PCR).
Micromix the reaction mixture for 60 minutes during the RT reaction.
Conduct qPCR on duplicate samples to obtain consistent signal traces.
Perform melting curve analysis on qPCR products to identify appropriate PCR products.
Generate negative controls by excluding cDNA from qPCR reactions.
